### Xenonid Castes
Strain guides can be found attached to their parent caste.
Xenomorphs and neomorphs recognize hosts by their role. Commanders are Empress Hosts, executive officers are Queen Hosts, squad and fireteam leaders are Leader Hosts, radio traffic operators are Antennae Hosts, and machinegunners are Fast-Spitter Hosts. Other roles have descriptive names such as Healer Host, Builder Host, and Warrior Host. The identifying number suffix is unchanged. Synthetics retain their synthetic names, and allied hosts remain recognizable to their allied hive.
